answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27525 Country: India Title: I wanted to know that killing lizard is lawful or not? Question: As Salaam Alaikum Mufti sb. I wanted to know that killing lizard is lawful or not. Jazaak Allah Khair Answer ID: 27525 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
